title: Cambion Drift/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Transmissions during general Cambion Drift Bounties. For transmissions inside Isolation Vaults see Isolation Vault/Quotes.

- Mother: "Aggression from the Infested is a given, but it cannot be allowed to go unchecked. Loid can direct you to locations where the Infested are massing to breach our perimeter. Work to cull their numbers for the security of us all."
- Loid: "Infested breach point located. Proceed to the breach point indicated, then―"
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Motile Infested aggressor incursions imminent. Prepare for defense."
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Breach point of Infested aggressors detected."
- Otak: "Oh boy, here we go! Are we gonna start some play time at the breach?"
- Otak: "Here's the Infested breach. Are we going to make some new friends?"
- Loid: "Congratulations, Infested activity has been reduced to within acceptable parameters."
- Loid: "No further hostiles detected. Breach designation: closed. Until next time."
- Otak: "That's the way! A good―no, a great haul! You got a great nose for this Chip. Wish I had a nose."
- Otak: "Check you out! You big old treasure hunter, you. You're amazing!"
- Otak: "You're king of the hill! That was outstanding, my Tenno. I'm gonna make you a crown!"
- Otak: "Our squiggly new friends look all tuckered out. They won't be coming back... for a while at least."
- Loid: "Infested activity registers at zero. Well done, Tenno."
- Loid: "All hostiles eliminated. Breach designation: crushed! Good job, Tenno."
- Otak: "Wow. You're fan-tiddly-astic at this. Those little old artifacts never stood a chance."
- Otak: "No way, I think you got everything. What makes you so good at this? It's me, isn't it? I make you good!"
- Otak: "Wow. You're the best dancer on all of Deimos. Our squiggly new friends are totally tired out."
- Otak: "Guess we won't be seeing our squiggly friends ever again. No, I'm sure they will be back some day."
- Mother: "I feel sympathy for them, sometimes. After all, they're just acting naturally. As naturally as can be expected for a macroplague. We're the real monsters here, after all."
- Mother: "Another cycle continues unbroken. They rise, they attack, they are repelled. At least you dealt with them with merciful efficiency. I applaud that."
- Mother: "A tragic waste of flesh and blood, in a way... but what are we to do? We cannot simply sit back and allow the Infested to consume us, can we?"
- Mother: "The Infested had been put back in their place, I gather? They will return, I have no doubt of that. I hope you will be able to help us again when they do."
> “Hunt down anomalous samples in the Deimos biome.”

- Mother: "I'm sure you've apprehended by now that Deimos is not as it should be. Several anomalous objects worthy of study have come up in recent scans. Loid can take you through the retrieval process."
- Loid: "Anomalous objects were scanned within this region. Be on the look out for―"
- Otak: "Don't be silly. Retrieving them won't make a difference."
- Loid: "I have detected a nearby cache that may be the source of an anomaly. Kindly locate it."
- Loid: "Anomalous object secured. Keep searching. There are more out there."
- Otak: "Wow, you got all the pieces, and the big puppy too! I wonder what it's been chewing on to get like that."
- Loid: "The anomaly appears to be buried. You will need to use an excavator to reach it."
- Otak: "Those old diggers sure can go, right? We got deep enough. You can stop now."
- Otak: "Well okay then, Mr. Smarty-Pants. All of the excavators made it through their cycles. You rock at this! Pun fully intended!"
- Otak: "Hey, there's a Corpus researcher close by. Latrox Une! I'll bet he'll help us if we help him."
- Loid: "I successfully established a link with the research's data stream. Interesting. Proceed to the indicated location. I believe I found something noteworthy."
- Loid: "Well done! Full sample upload complete. This data will be invaluable in cleansing Deimos."
- Loid: "I am detecting Grineer transmissions in the area. Somewhat panicked ones, to be precise. Please investigate and render assistance. We are mutual enemies of the Infestation."
- Otak: "Everything's better with new friends, don't you think? Oh, and I got the coordinates of where to go next off them. Nice guys!"
- Loid: "You have achieved double the Grineer's kill count and saved the day! A salutatory lesson in lethality I'm sure they won't forget."
- Loid: "According to the scan data, this is the final location. Whatever is buried here represents the most unique anomaly detected. Please proceed with extraction."
- Mother: "Loid tells me you have retrieved the samples I wanted. I am pleased. I suppose you should have a reward for your efforts."
- Mother: "Loid tells me you have exceeded expectations by retrieving all the samples I desired. You have materially assisted my progress through your activities. Well done, Tenno."
> “Deimos artifacts are always in demand. Bring back as many as you can!
> Each stage of an Endless Bounty rewards +15% Extra Mother Tokens for every round completed. ” —In-Game Description

- Mother: "Location and retrieval of Deimos artifacts is always a priority. The data I can collect from them is a valuable resource in its own right. If you want to join the hunt, then Loid can direct you to some likely spots. Bring back all you can carry."
- Loid: "Artifacts are located in the indicated zones. Infested subtrate will require removal prior to―"
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Deimos artifacts are located nearby. Commence retrieval when ready."
- Loid: "Archival data indicates artifacts can be found in the vicinity. Collection advised."
- Otak: "You smell that, Chip? Smells like artifacts. You know, treasure."
- Otak: "Ready to get rich, Chip? There's artifacts close by. You go ahead and grab them!"
- Loid: "Artifact collection complete. Proceed to debrief before cataloging and archiving."
- Loid: "A satisfactory quantity of artifacts, I suppose. You will be adequately recompensed for your efforts."
- Loid: "An impressive display, Tenno! Artifact retrieval parameters exceeded. Additional reward incentives have been authorized."
- Loid: "I find it interesting you have such an obsession with artifact hunting. Truly no stone left unturned."
- Mother: "You have restored a great deal to us, Tenno. More than you know, I think. Your dedication and simple-mindedness is... admirable, I suppose."
- Mother: "Thank you. We've lost so much to the Infestation over time. But it was necessary. Absolutely necessary. Or so I thought."
- Mother: "More lost treasures for the collection. I appreciate your efforts to reclaim what we cannot. I hope the compensation I can offer is adequate."
- Mother: "Ah, most pleasing, Tenno. I don't hold any delusions that we can regain our former glory. I'm not such a fool. But seeing these again is a comfort to me."
> “A squad of Grineer soldiers stranded on Deimos have activated their SOS beacon. Track them down and see what you can do to help.”

- Mother: "Grineer may be unsavory, but ultimately they are not the Infested and we need all the help we can get. Kindly locate and assist a stranded squad of Grineer. Rest assured they will be non-hostile, these Grineer fully grasp their situation here."
- Otak: "Weee! I always like the grunters. So funny!"
- Loid: "A large predator roams this area. It must be neutralized before we can attempt to locate the Grineer. Advice: look for appropriate bait."
- Loid: "It is likely the Grineer ran into difficulties when they encountered this organism. Continue your search, Tenno."
- Otak: "Shhh. The big puppy and its momma are taking a nap. You rule at playtime."
- Otak: "Oh hey, there's a cache! Maybe the grunters left it behind. We should try and open it!"
- Loid: "The contents of this cache appear to be Corpus in origin. Useful but not what we are looking for. Continue, Tenno!"
- Loid: "An impressive victory, Tenno. Sadly the cache itself gives us no clues about the Grineer. Although the resources it contains are always welcome."
- Loid: "There are Grineer artifacts buried in the Infested substrate nearby. Activate purifiers so we can get a better look at them."
- Otak: "These look old, I don't think they're from the squad we're looking for. Shame. No wait, that means they're still alive. Maybe? Yay!"
- Loid: "Excellent data recovery, Tenno. It appears that some Grineer lost a fight with Infested here, but that wasn't long ago. We need to keep searching."
- Loid: "A large concentration of Infested are close by. They must be dealt with before we attempt to locate the Grineer."
- Otak: "Maybe these were what chewed on the grunters. They don't normally like asking for help, you know."

path: Final Stage: Protect the Grineer Squad
lines: - Loid: "I have a positive fix on the Grineer beacon. Please move to assist."
- Mother: "I'm sure that the Grineer will be able make it out on their own, now. Thank you for indulging me, Tenno. All non-Infested are allies and we need allies."

- Mother: "The poor Grineer are out of peril thanks to your charitable efforts. Such a demonstration of your destructive power is also... helpful in keeping the peace, should they ever consider becoming... aggressive."
> “A powerful Infested entity has been terrorizing teams out in Deimos. Find it, and deal with it”

- Mother: "The Infestation is a marvel, in its own way. An endless fountain of ever-changing flesh, bone, and gristle. A particularly murderous specimen has been reported assaulting other teams. Would you be so kind as to find it and put an end to it?"
- Loid: "Warning. You are now in the region indicated in the reports of a―quote―murderous―unquote―Infested. Caution."
- Otak: "I can't wait to meet our new Mr. Bitey Scratchikins!"
- Otak: "I don't think we found Mr. Scratchikins, but I think we found some of his friends!"
- Loid: "Hostiles eliminated. None of these appear dangerous enough to fit the rather colorful descriptions of the Infested we are hunting. Keep looking, Tenno."
- Loid: "Carnage comprehensively complete. Additional incentives/rewards have been authorized. Well done, Tenno."
- Loid: "You'll need to create a killing zone. Activate local excavators to clear yourself some room to maneuver."
- Otak: "All done. You're abso-tively, posi-lutely the best of what's left!"
- Loid: "Excellent work, Tenno. With the ground well-prepared, we can proceed to the next step."
- Loid: "It will be necessary to clear nearby Infested in order to achieve optimal hunting conditions. Please proceed when ready."
- Otak: "Well, that showed them. I don't think any of those is Mr. Scratchikins, though. He's a slippery one."
- Otak: "I bet if you check in with the Grineer survivors, they can point you to Mr. Scratchikins!"
- Loid: "The Grineer confirmed losing several squad members to the Infested you are hunting. I have uploaded coordinates to where the encounter occurred."
- Otak: "Wow, the grunters can't keep up with you. They look all mad. They said we should play with Mr. Scratchikins if we're so [REDACTED]."
- Loid: "There is a strong possibility the target can be lured here with the current bait. Locate the relevant ingredients to proceed."
- Mother: "The Cephalons tell me the Infested specimen was located and slain. A small victory, but victory nonetheless."

- Mother: "Loid tells me the target was eliminated, along with a perhaps deadlier secondary target. Two entities working together would go a long way to explain the most lurid stories. A most satisfactory outcome."
> “Search Deimos for valuable geological core samples.”

- Mother: "It is vital that we gain a proper understanding of the Infestation on Deimos in order to protect the Heart. Loid will instruct you how to procure geological core samples in relevant areas. This would be a great help to me."
- Loid: "Geological core samples can be procured nearby that will reveal vital data about Deimos Infestation levels. Please."
- Otak: "Just ignore them and blast Infested. It'll do more good."
- Loid: "There is an apex Infested in this area that you'll need to deal with before you take a core sample. Prepare some bait and draw it out."
- Otak: "The big puppy is taking a nap. You tired him out good, Chip. And you got a core sample, too!"
- Loid: "Taking down the apex alone would have been sufficient. Just had to prove yourself, hmm?"
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Eliminate local Infested aggressors in order to procure a core sample."
- Otak: "Now that's all done with, I suppose you can grab a core sample!"
- Otak: "Contact our Corpus friend Latrox. He can help you get a core sample if you protect him!"
- Loid: "Latrox has now routed core sample data to us, Tenno. He does have his uses."
- Loid: "Excellent. Latrox has collected a number of samples on our behalf. Well done, Tenno."
- Otak: "There's some Grineer survivors working 'round here that might help out! I should've baked cookies."
- Loid: "Well done, Tenno! That little fracas has secured us a core sample from the grateful Grineer."
- Loid: "Based on the other core samples, I have located the best place to get the final set. Proceed to the excavators!"
- Mother: "I'm told you have extracted a set of core samples. Good work, Tenno. I believe we're done here."
- Mother: "Loid tells me you got all the core samples needed, and more. Excellent. These will give me considerable insights into the problem."
> “Help a stranded Corpus agent with his mission to bring Infested samples to the Entrati for science!...or Profit?”

- Mother: "Unsurprisingly, you are not our only guest. A stranded Corpus agent, Latrox Une, has run into difficulties amid the Grey Strain. Latrox is useful at times. Kindly see if you can help him at all?"
- Latrox: "Hello? Anyone? This is Corpus Representative Latrox Une. I'm lost, cornered by Infested, and my locator, is well... it's been eaten. I'm in the direst need of assistance. Help?"
- Latrox: "Perhaps if you bait out the prime Infested in the area... and kill it, you might then retrieve me. You can do that, right?"
- Latrox: "With the larger fellow out of the way, maybe there's a chance for me yet. Salvation!"
- Latrox: "You exterminated both the alpha specimen and its mother? Most impressive and unlikely. But impressive! Is the next step, by any chance, saving me?"
- Latrox: "You must locate me. I was near a purifier before I got chased off. I remember that much. Perhaps look around there. Try to pick up my trail."
- Latrox: "Oh perfect! Your signal is getting stronger. So you are getting closer to my position. Please keep at it."
- Latrox: "My stars! Those chimeric monstrosities were never provided the remotest chance of disrupting things. You're terrifying. Well, come save me."
- Latrox: "I... I think you maybe stumbled on some sort of nest. There's a lot more Infested showing up out there. Guard yourself, Tenno."
- Latrox: "Goodness! You Tenno really are scary as they say. Oh, I'm getting a positive fix on you. Please keep going."
- Latrox: "They... they barely breached your perimeter. You are almost to me. Don't stop now!"
- Latrox: "Oh, oh, uh. Those pack of monstrosities that were chasing me gave up around there. I'm sure they've all called off by now, should be perfectly safe."
- Latrox: "Well, if I'd had you around, I never would've got into this mess. Keep looking, Tenno. I think you're close."

path: Final Stage: Protect the Corpus Scientist
lines: - Latrox: "You made it! Oh, I could kiss those scary metal feet of yours. One last favor. Please watch my back while I collect the last of my samples. I can't go back empty-handed after all this."
- Mother: "Congratulations, Tenno. As I said, Une has his uses. The sample data he just sent, for example, is... acceptable."
- Mother: "It's always nice to have one's expectations exceeded. You saved Une, and he in turn sent a large quantity of data. Most agreeable."
> “We are trying to regain a foothold out in Deimos. There are old bases lost to the Infestation that we need to reclaim.”

- Mother: "The Infestation has covered them now, but there are key installations on Deimos that could still serve us well. Locating and securing one of these places will help the reclamation. Loid can give you the details."
- Loid: "Ahold(?). There was an Entrati base installation in this region. See if you can―"
- Otak: "Are you gonna look for the old base near here? I'd love to see it again!"
- Loid: "A large, predatory organism in the vicinity must be removed before we can reclaim the base. Use bait to lure it out."
- Otak: "Hey, hey, who's the king? That's right, you're the king! Long live the king!"
- Loid: "Parameters exceeded. Well done, Tenno. In my defense, there was no indication of a second entity. Let alone one so... unpleasant."
- Otak: "Oh, hey, hey, there's a cache nearby. Maybe see if you can open it! We could use the resources inside to fix the base!"
- Loid: "Good work, Tenno. There are useful materials here that will assist us in the reclamation project."
- Otak: "Oh boy, did you just use the cache to lure that humongous thing out? Brilliant."
- Loid: "It will be necessary to clear the area of hostile Infested before any positive inroads can be made to reclaiming the base."
- Loid: "Efficiently done! Now we can continue the restoration project unimpeded."
- Loid: "Researcher Latrox Une has agreed assist our reclamation efforts. Please protect him while he conducts the necessary survey."
- Otak: "Friend Latrox says we all clear to proceed. He says we're in the right area and everything. This is so exciting!"
- Loid: "Excellent work, Tenno. With Latrox's help, we now have full scan data for the area around the base."
- Loid: "You are in proximity to the base location. Once I reactivate the dormant elements, the Infested will attempt to prevent completion of the process. Prepare for area defense."
- Mother: "All clear. Loid tells me there are strong connections across the network. The reclamation is a success."
- Mother: "The site has been restored and Loid tells me it went even better than we hoped. Very well done, Tenno."
> “Many resource caches lie abandoned and unclaimed on Deimos, find them and they are yours.”

- Mother: "Over the years, many expeditions of both Grineer and Corpus have become trapped on Deimos. Caches of resources left behind by the survivors still dot the surface. See what you can find and bring back. Loid will show you where to look"
- Loid: "Scan logs have registered a substantial cache of lost resources in this area."
- Otak: "Time to make some new friends. Best brush your teeth! Wait, do you even have teeth?"
- Loid: "The Corpus researcher Latrox Une is in the area. Seek his assistance for cache reclamation."
- Otak: "Well, Friend Latrox has marked off a few places not to look. I guess we keep going to the other places."
- Loid: "Latrox has his uses, but he seems clueless about the location of any caches. He's likely lying to keep them for himself. Corpus is as Corpus does."
- Loid: "I have located a squad of Grineer survivors in the area. Questioning them may assist in finding any abandoned loot."
- Otak: "Okay, so Mr. Grunty waved his fist and said something rude when I asked him about caches, so I don't think he knows about any."
- Loid: "Given the poor performance of those Grineer, it's a good bet they haven't found any cachés lately. Keep looking."
- Otak: "Hmm, maybe you could use a purifier. The cache might be covered up by squelchies."
- Loid: "Some useful data was revealed, but the primary cache has not been located. Keep looking, Tenno."
- Loid: "That is a positive wealth of data, but sadly not the data we are looking for. Nonetheless, good work, Tenno."
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Multiple Infested aggressors. Secure the area to continue with cache reclamation mission."
- Otak: "That's it, you're all clear. Now... where were we?"
- Loid: "Excellent work, Tenno. With the Infested so comprehensively out of the picture, you should be clear to proceed."
- Otak: "Oh, hey, there's a cache near here. Maybe it's the one we're looking for!"
- Mother: "Loid tells me you have a cache unlocked. A decent enough haul for our collective efforts. I'm not sure what we would do without these occasional windfalls"
- Mother: "According to Loid, you located a cache and brought additional bounties home along with it. Very good, Tenno. I'm starting to like you."
> “There are resources for the taking just beneath 'skin' of the Infestation covering Deimos. Dig for victory!
> Each stage of an Endless Bounty rewards +15% Extra Mother Tokens for every round completed. ” —In-Game Description

- Mother: "It may not look like it now, but Deimos is rich in natural resources. These resources can still be liberated by strip mining the Infested substrate in designated areas. Tenno, if you have a mind to go digging, Loid can show you the most fruitful spots."
- Loid: "Strip mining for resources can be accomplished in indicated zones. Being processing when―"
- Otak: "Oh boy, you gonna do it? There's gold in them there hills!"
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Strip mining zones are located nearby. Commence mining when ready."
- Loid: "Scan data indicates natural resources in this area. Strip mining recommended."
- Otak: "Are you going to do some mining, Chip? Can I come along, too?"
- Otak: "Huh, what are the chances we'd end up in a mining spot? You're so lucky."
- Loid: "Resource extraction completed within satisfactory parameters. Kindly undertake further extraction operations when ready."
- Loid: "Although crude, strip mining is the most efficient method to use for resource extraction. It's not we have to worry about marring Deimos' natural beauty."
- Otak: "Wow, you've tapped out the whole seam. Isn't it time to go home?"
- Otak: "You're really good at this. Shouldn't you get a reward now?"
- Loid: "Operation complete. Baseline parameters... exceeded. Congratulations, Tenno, on your exceptional performance. Well done, Tenno."
- Loid: "Your virulent oppression of the unresisting Infested substrate is truly impressive. It does make me wonder of your motivation."
- Otak: "I can't believe how much you did there. Well to go above and beyond, Chip!"
- Otak: "Incredible. You make it look so easy. How did you learn to do that? Can you teach me?"
- Mother: "A sterling effort, I suppose. Do enjoy the fruits of your labor."
- Mother: "Very good, very good. You see, Deimos is unforgiving, but not without its gems hidden beneath the mire. Every scrap and crumb is welcome."
- Mother: "Loid informs you have excelled yourself. With more help like yours, perhaps we can turn the tide. Perhaps."
- Mother: "It's a little unseemly, isn't it? Grubbing for resources like some rockhopper. Essential though - we couldn't continue without it. How far we have fallen."
- Loid: "Mission parameters have been violated. The mission is no longer tenable."
- Otak: "Oh no, you can't complete the mission now. Boo!"
- Loid: "Well, that was less than ideal, wasn't it? Mission failed."
- Otak: "Oh tough luck! You can't finish the mission now, so there'll no cake for anyone. Frowny face."
- Loid: "Mission objective now unachievable. Fantastic. Now we are now just going to have to start over."
- Loid: "I have located a suitable vessel to use in creating the bait."
- Loid: "You should see a cauldron-like outgrowth close-by you can use as a vessel to make the bait."
- Loid: "Use the vessel nearby to make the bait."
- Loid: "Finding the parts necessary to make bait should not be too hard. Take down a few Infested and... look for parts."
- Loid: "I suggest eliminating Infested in the vicinity to secure bait construction materials."
- Loid: "In order to proceed, you will now need to gather materials."
- Loid: "Good. Now place the materials in the vessel and start the infusion process."
- Loid: "That should be sufficient. Use the vessel to begin infusing the bait."
- Loid: "We are now ready to begin the bait infusion. Move to the vessel to proceed."
- Loid: "Infested will now be drawn to the infusion. Terminate them close to the vessel to expedite the process."
- Loid: "This will draw more Infested. Dispatch them while they are close to the vessel in order to complete the bait."
- Loid: "This will lure Infested to the area. Kill them near the vessel to finish concocting the bait."
- Loid: "Warning: Juggernaut inbound. Kill it close to the vessel to enhance the bait."
- Loid: "An apex Infested is approaching. Slay it near the bait vessel to infuse its ichor for improved effect."
- Otak: "You got a big boy comin'. Stuff that in your bait box to max it out."
- Loid: "Shame to have missed an opportunity. Still, the bait remains usable if... mundane."
- Loid: "That is unfortunate. You can still the bait, it just lacks that added umph."
- Otak: "Never mind then. We all miss out sometimes, you know? Bait's still good, just... not... extra good."
- Otak: "Hey! You got the big guy, huh? With that gore in the mix, the bait's gonna be irresistible."
- Loid: "Elimination of this enemy has substantially improved the effectiveness of the bait."
- Loid: "Good work! Extra effort that I believe will pay off handsomely."
**If killing enemies outside of vessel range**
- Otak: "That's no good. You got to bonk the Infested near the jug or we'll get nowhere."
- Loid: "Only Infested that are terminated in proximity to the vessel contribute to the infusion."
- Loid: "If the Infested are eliminated too far from the vessel, this will not work."
- Loid: "Bait successfully deployed. The desired target is approaching. Eliminate it to fulfill mission parameters."
- Loid: "Proximity alert. Baited target has arrived. Immediate termination is advised."
- Loid: "Ah, the main event has arrived. Here's your chance. Kill the target!"
- Loid: "Target eliminated! Congratulations on a job well done."
- Loid: "Confirmed target is down. Deimos just fractionally improved its odds of survival."
- Loid: "A flawless victory. Well, effective anyways. The target is no more."
- Loid: "Enhanced targets eradicated! Going the extra mile there?"
- Loid: "Target down! Eliminating this enhanced opponent will prove worth the trouble, I think."
- Loid: "Objective complete! Enhanced target terminated. Arousing display of martial vigor."
- Loid: "These caches are often left by shipwrecked crews. They are usually worth investigation."
- Loid: "Caches like these often contain valuable data as well as resources. Please find a way to access it."
- Otak: "What's in the box? We got to know what's in the box, right?"
- Loid: "You will need to release the cache before we can access it. See if you can damage that growth."
- Loid: "You will need to the release the cache before we can access it."
- Otak: "The Infestation's got that box gripped tight. Blast that sucker!"
- Loid: "Look for pulsating trails connecting to other, nearby tumors."
- Loid: "The growth over the cache is seemingly invulnerable. Look for any Infested tumors linked to it."
- Otak: "Nothing. Maybe we can find another way to break it free. What's that connected to it?"
- Otak: "Smacking down on these tumors seems to be doing something. Keep doing that!"
- Loid: "The Infested substrate has formed tumors anchoring the cache. Blast them free."
- Loid: "I have detected these tumors are maintaining a grip on the cache. You'll need to burst them."
- Loid: "That is the last small tumor. Now return to the main growth and break it open."
- Loid: "Well that was... unpleasant. Still, you have done enough to make the main tumor vulnerable now."
- Otak: "That should be enough. Try and break open the box again."
- Otak: "Aw, hey, no fair! There's a protective cloud over the Infestation. You got to get inside it to hurt the blobs!"
- Loid: "The Infestation is protecting itself with a sort of... barrier membrane. Move inside the barrier before attempting to damage the Infestation."
- Loid: "Interesting. There is a sporoidal barrier protecting the Infestation. Get inside it before attacking."
- Loid: "No no no, you cannot breach the―You cannot breach the Infestation from outside its protective barrier."
- Otak: "No damage. You got to get inside that bubble to do anything to the growth!"
- Loid: "As I predicted, no harm can be inflicted from outside the Infested barrier. Proceed inside."
- Loid: "Very good. Now we shall see what the cache holds."
- Loid: "Excellent. You should be able to retrieve the cache now."
- Loid: "Cache is open and contents secured."
- Loid: "Infestation defeated. The cache held some valuable data."
- Otak: "Well, blasting things was more fun than opening the box."
- Loid: "A job well done. You have exceeded projected expectations."
- Loid: "Efficiently procured. The additional cache contents should prove invaluable."
- Otak: "Wow, you were quick. So quick, I reckon you saved more of the box contents!"
- Loid: "Autonomous excavation units can be found in the vicinity."
- Loid: "I have located excavation units that may prove useful for this next task."
- Otak: "We need to find a way to dig down. Guess we can use those digging machines."
- Loid: "I have detected a high concentration of resources in this area. Dispatching excavator units for exploitation."
- Loid: "Scanning. Detecting subsurface resources. Excavation units en route. Kindly assist in their deployment."
- Otak: "Hey, there's a ton of resources buried around here. I'm calling in the diggers!"
- Loid: "An excavator has completed its digging cycle."
- Loid: "An excavator reports: mining sequence complete."
- Otak: "Green light! That's a digger finished digging."
- Loid: "An excavator has been severely damaged. Do try to keep ii functional."
- Loid: "Severe damage has been registered to an excavation unit. Please prioritize it."
- Otak: "One of the diggers is getting smashed up! Don't let it blow up or we'll lose out!"
- Loid: "An excavation unit has been disabled. Kindly prioritize protection of the surviving units."
- Loid: "We have lost an excavator. Focus on protecting the rest."
- Otak: "Oh man, we lost a digger. Better be super careful with the rest."
- Loid: "An excavator has powered down. If you can scavenge an energy source, it can brought back online."
